note: GFP recreation area on Lake Francis Case (Missouri River) 14 mi W of Platte off SD-44. Two campgrounds about 650 m apart on the shore, the front rows on open grass above the riprap; 10 camping cabins, a marina concession, boat ramps, fish cleaning station and swimming beach. Four sites (37, 75, 77, 79) have no electric. --Claude
